stdout: VDE Unified Command - The Sovereign Orchestrator
Usage: vde <command> [arguments]
Core Commands:
init            Initialize the VDE Forge, generate configs, and smelting foundation images.
create <name>   Forge a specific VM Spoke or cluster. Resolves aliases and units.
rebuild <name>  Destroy and re-forge a Spoke (use --no-cache to ignore Docker layer cache).
start <name>    Ignite a Spoke or cluster (e.g., 'vde start default').
stop <name>     Quench a running Spoke or cluster unit.
restart <name>  Reset a Spoke or cluster unit.
remove <name>   Remove Spoke containers and ephemeral state.
nuke            The Nuclear Option: Complete erasure of all VDE artifacts and data.
Spoke Operations:
enter <name>    Enter a Spoke's login shell (Zsh) via the Transversal Bridge.
exec <name> <c> Execute a command inside a Spoke without interactive shell.
ssh <name>      Connect to a Spoke via raw SSH using the VDE identity.
logs <name>     Tail logs for a specific Spoke or cluster unit.
Diagnostics & Discovery:
audit           Verify the structural integrity of the Sovereign Artifact Set.
check-tetrad    Verify the Unyielding Tetrad (Zsh, Git, Docker, SSH) and core integrity.
heal            Autonomously synchronize the Gospel with the physical Forge.
dns-check <s> <t> Verify DNS resolution between Source and Target Spokes.
info <name>     Display detailed metadata and registry status for a Spoke.
ps              List all active VDE containers and their statuses.
networks        List and manage VDE Docker networks.
health          Execute the Sovereign Audit for the Hub and infrastructure.
function-trace  Trace the full function call chain for a command without executing it.
stats <name>    Display real-time resource usage for Spokes.
port <name>     Retrieve the specific SSH or service port for an alias.
validate        Verify the integrity of Beskar Registry schemas.
sync-context    Review and refresh VDE context docs against current codebase.
Matrix Management:
matrix-audit    Exhaustive verification of every registered VM type (Serialized).
matrix-rebuild  Comprehensive non-cached re-forging of the absolute Spoke matrix.
cluster <act>   Manage named units (save, list, start, stop, remove).
Paths:
path-of-the-foundling  Guide a new warrior through the VDE setup rituals.
Version: 1.5.6
This is the Way.
